summary_md: **GridPin ([@gridpinn](https://x.com/gridpinn/status/2116083535970808163))** releases **gridpin-mcp**, a local, key-free MCP server offering geocode, reverse and batch tools, installable with one `claude mcp add` command ([gridpin/gridpin MCP README](https://github.com/gridpin/gridpin/blob/main/mcp/README.md)).
relevance: Free local geocoding tool for agents.
